title: Dimension-Free Lipschitz Bounds for Brenier Maps to Compactly Supported Log-Concave Targets
summary: We fix an integer $d\ge1$ and a symmetric positive-definite matrix $Q\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$. Let $V:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ be finite, set \[ Z_μ:=\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}e^{-V(x)}\,dx\in(0,\infty), \qquad dμ(x):=Z_μ^{-1}e^{-V(x)}\,dx, \] and assume that $μ$ has finite second moment and that \[ x\longmapsto \frac12\langle Qx,x\rangle-V(x) \] is convex. Let $ν$ be a compactly supported log-concave probability measure with support $K$, and let $\nablaΦ$ be the Brenier map from $μ$ to $ν$.
